issues.description: The return type of messageOnMilk() is inconsistent across the problem statement UML, the textual task description, and the reference solution. The UML snippet in the problem states Milkable.messageOnMilk(): boolean and the textual description (Part 2) says messageOnMilk() should return true/false, while the class method signatures in the UML for Seal/Goat and the provided solution implement messageOnMilk() as returning String. This conflict will confuse students about whether messageOnMilk() should return a boolean or a String and blocks correct implementation.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of messageOnMilk() consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) change the problem statement UML and textual description to specify messageOnMilk(): String and describe the expected message format (e.g. "[AnimalType] [name] is milked"), matching the solution; or (B) change the solution and interface to return boolean and update example outputs and tests accordingly. Prefer option A to align with the existing solution and the class-level UML entries.
